answer: A concrete approach: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The mesa of work and the nebula of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a tundra to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
